message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

The `nickname` column couldn't go in a new migration, because `migrations/` is off-limits. Instead, `src/migrate.js` adds the column after the migrations run, if it isn't already there. Nothing under `migrations/` was touched.

Changes:
- **`src/migrate.js`**: adds the `nickname` column to `users` after the migration loop.
- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` stores `nickname` (defaulting to `null`), and `getUser` returns it as `nickname`.

The DBA team may want the real schema change to live in a migration. If so, they can add it there and remove the fallback line in `migrate.js`.
